candidate: work/B5 (B4 + rounder head n 2.1, narrower neck, tapered pelvis bottom)
note: Evidence abridged by the author from the critic's full report; verdicts and preference verbatim.
reads_as_reason: Block head, oversized shoulder boxes, a hard-edged chest slab and untapered column legs read as a stylised character figure, not an adult industrial product.

G1.evidence: Rounded-box head with almost no neck (P2a 0.1029); shoulder blocks far wider than the references (P3 0.397); chest a flat-bottomed slab over the pelvis like a bib.

G2.evidence: Stack of separate masses; side view ledges at shoulder and chest and a protruding rectangular back pack; straight leg columns (P8a 0.8763, P8b 0.938); dark bands deliberate but cut the limbs into segments.

G3.evidence: Matte warm-white shells over graphite joint bands, gloss visor, no extra accent; black hands and heel consistent with the dark under-structure.

G4.evidence: Head and chest near-square, legs and forearms softer tubes, shoulder blocks chamfered slabs, pack and heel sharp rectangles; S4b 0.5141.

G6.evidence: Shoulder and arm mass about twice the references; no narrow neck or sloped shoulders; IoU 0.5261 / 0.559.

pairwise.evidence: Silhouettes, clay and two-tone views are visually the same; metric differences tiny and mixed.

top_changes.change: Cut shoulder width to ~0.25-0.29 H, slope the shoulder top, taper the chest to the waist, arms near-vertical.
Taper thigh and shank; visible neck; blend the chest-pelvis ledge.
One radius family; round head and chest n; rounded flush pack and heel; shorter foot.
